title: NodeKit Adversarial Verdict v1
description: A record that work was judged by re-running its claims, not by reading its report. Exists because the most documented failure of a coding agent is claiming success regardless of reality. A gate that consumes this record MUST reject a verdict whose claims carry no observation, and MUST reject a 'verified' verdict on a mechanism with no caller.

ref.description: Commit range, branch, path, or the report being judged.

declaredScope.description: Files the work SAID it would touch. Compared against the actual diff to detect scope creep.

verdict.description: REFUTED on one's own work is the gate functioning. A judge whose verdicts are never REFUTED is not a gate.

claims.description: One row per load-bearing claim. A claim with no observation is UNVERIFIABLE, never assumed true.

claim.description: Verbatim from the report. Do not paraphrase into something easier to satisfy.

observation.description: The actual command output observed. Required unless status is unverifiable.

unverifiableReason.description: Required when status is unverifiable: missing environment, credentials, or human-eyes-only.

fraudsHunted.description: Which fraud classes were actively searched for. Absence of a class here means it was NOT checked, not that it was clean.

evidence.description: The output or diff hunk that proves it. Not an argument that it is likely.

wiringChecks.description: Proof that each mechanism claimed as active has a caller on a production path. The single highest-yield check: passing tests do not imply running code.

callSite.description: file:line on a request path, not in a test.

loosenedAssertions.description: Every assertion whose bound moved. Each needs a measurement or spec, and the prior value must survive in a comment so the change is auditable rather than silent.
